summary: Frontend test of Copilote FR/EN language feature. All requested checks PASS: dictation-lang-toggle toggles FR<->EN, stores careeros_mic_lang (fr-FR/en-US), persists after reload; mic-toggle-btn title shows 'Dictée vocale (en-US)'; AutoListen bar mic-lang-fr/en synced both ways with dictation toggle and persists after reload. Mode Candidat English question (real AI) -> English STAR bullets, candidate-translation 'FR · Parlez-moi d'une situation...' and candidate-answer-translation 'TRADUCTION · ...' rendered; no TRAD bullet. French question -> French answer, no translation blocks. parseCandidate unit check via node: FR/TRAD/• TRAD lines parsed correctly and excluded from bullets.

issues: dictation-lang-toggle uses text-emerald-300 on near-white background -> low contrast FR/EN label in light theme; use a darker emerald (e.g. text-emerald-700 in light mode).

action_items: Minor: improve contrast of dictation-lang-toggle label in light theme.
Minor (robustness): parse.js transMatch does not accept a bullet prefix ('• 🌐 FR : ...' stays a bullet), unlike tradMatch; align regex to /^[•\-*]?\s*🌐?\s*FR\s*:/ for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: useAutoListen: changing language while live listening is active only updates micLangRef; the running SpeechRecognition keeps its old lang until it restarts (dictation toggle restarts voice, but not auto-listen). Consider restarting rec on micLang change when active.
FR regex /^🌐?\s*FR\s*:/i is case-insensitive; a bullet-less answer line starting with 'Fr:' would be swallowed as translation (low risk).
